title: Pragmatic and Enthusiastic Programmer
heroCumpliment: First of all, thank you for checking out my portfolio and wanting to know more about me!  I'm Daniel Oliveira, a software developer based in Porto, Portugal. I currently work at Innux Technologies, where I collaborate on several commercial projects.
aboutBrief: From building desktop and mobile apps to APIs and robust web applications, I love creating innovative solutions.  I strive to stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and am committed to continuous learning and growth.
aboutExtra: That being said, I’m always open to learning new technologies. For example, this portfolio is built with React and TypeScript — tech I hadn’t used extensively until recently. I enjoy working on web, desktop, and the occasional CLI tool, especially when it solves a real problem or helps someone out. Exploring different areas, from .NET to TypeScript and beyond, keeps coding interesting for me.
aboutActivitiesTitle: Apart from coding, here are some other activities I love:
